title: Cars
paras: Many people ride in cars every day.
Cars get people from one place to another.
Cars have a body and four wheels.
The steering wheel turns the wheels.
The seats and controls are inside the car.
The seat belts and air bags keep you safe.
The headlights help the driver see at night.
Most cars need fuel to run.
They run on gas or diesel.
They run on a battery that is charged by electricity.
They often run on gas or diesel and a battery.
Smart cars are often used in the city.
They are small and easy to park.
Police cars have special lights and sirens.
These help others know the police car is coming.
